page.overview:
Who is Alan Ferranti?

Doctor Alan Ferranti was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century. His serial number was FSN 345-43-0054.

In 2364, he was a medical practitioner aboard the . On or about stardate 41044.2, according to an order sent by Commodore Bill Marafe of Starbase 55, he was scheduled for a transfer to the . (, okudagram)
